tldr: 台股 11/25 重挫近 4.8% 收約 38,195 點，外資單日大賣逾 1,236 億元，11 月跌幅直逼金融海嘯以來最慘的單月表現。
美股 11/25 尾盤戲劇性翻紅，道瓊抹去盤中 1,100 點跌幅收高，那斯達克也從盤中逾 4% 重挫大幅收斂，AI 類股震盪劇烈。
金管會持續推動結構性改革，放寬保險業經理人跨域人才資格，並敲定穩定幣發行初期限銀行或金融業合資的管理辦法草案。

items.title_zh: 台股重挫 4.8%、外資落跑，單月跌幅直逼 2008 金融海嘯
items.title_en: TAIEX plunges 4.8% as foreign funds flee, index heads for worst month since 2008
items.summary_zh: 加權指數 11/25 暴跌約 1,927 點、跌幅 4.80%，收在約 38,195 點，盤中震盪逾 3,300 點，尾盤靠逢低買盤稍收斂。外資主板單日賣超淨額達 1,236.5 億元，台積電跌 3.59% 收 2,150 元。市場將跌勢歸因於美股劇烈震盪與美國新一輪關稅疑慮；11 月以來大盤累計已回落約 15%。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX tumbled about 1,927 points, or 4.80%, to roughly 38,195 on Nov 25, swinging more than 3,300 points intraday before bargain hunters trimmed losses. Foreign institutions sold a net NT$123.65 billion on the main board. TSMC fell 3.59% to NT$2,150. Dealers blamed US market volatility and fresh US tariff worries; the index has now shed about 15% in November.

items.title_zh: 台積電 ADR 溢價收斂至兩年新低，台北掛牌股價急起直追
items.title_en: TSMC's US ADR premium shrinks to a two-year low as Taipei shares catch up
items.summary_zh: 台積電美國 ADR 相對台股掛牌價的溢價已縮小至約 3.2%，為兩年多來最低，反映台北掛牌股價正在縮小估值落差。溢價收斂象徵本地股相對抗跌，且先前因 AI 行情大幅擴張的溢價正在降溫，為指數與 ADR 套利資金密切關注的訊號。
items.summary_en: The premium of TSMC's US-listed ADRs over its Taipei-listed shares has fallen to about 3.2%, its lowest in over two years, as the local shares close the valuation gap. The narrowing reflects relative resilience in the Taipei line and a cooling of the AI-driven premium that had widened sharply earlier in the cycle, a signal watched closely by index and ADR arbitrage flows.

items.title_zh: AI 泡沫疑慮重擊台積電與 SK 海力士，「黃仁勳行情」快速退潮
items.title_en: AI-bubble fears sink TSMC and SK Hynix as the 'Huang boost' fades fast
items.summary_zh: 輝達執行長黃仁勳樂觀談話帶動的短線反彈數日內即蒸發，市場對 AI 基礎建設支出與估值偏高的疑慮再起，重挫晶片股。台積電與記憶體大廠 SK 海力士領跌亞洲，凸顯半導體供應鏈對 AI 資本支出情緒、以及雲端客戶訂單是否放緩的高度敏感。
items.summary_en: A short-lived rally sparked by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's upbeat comments evaporated within days as renewed worries over AI-infrastructure spending and stretched valuations hammered chip names. TSMC and memory maker SK Hynix led regional declines, underscoring how sensitive the semiconductor supply chain remains to shifts in AI capex sentiment and to any sign that hyperscaler orders could slow.

items.title_zh: 美國關稅疑慮加重晶片族群壓力
items.title_en: US tariff jitters add to chip-sector pressure
items.summary_zh: 除 AI 估值疑慮外，交易員指出市場擔心華府可能依 301 條款類型調查祭出新措施，直接衝擊以出口為主的台灣科技製造業。此一利空使本已脆弱的晶片供應鏈情緒雪上加霜，業者在終端需求與貿易政策訊號不明下，對擴增新產能趨於保守。
items.summary_en: Alongside AI valuation worries, dealers cited concern that Washington could impose fresh measures tied to a Section 301-type investigation, a risk that weighs directly on Taiwan's export-heavy technology manufacturers. The overhang compounds an already fragile mood in the chip supply chain, where buyers are wary of committing to new capacity amid uncertain end-demand and trade-policy signals.

items.title_zh: 金管會放寬保險業經理人跨域人才資格，由 7 類增至 12 類
items.title_en: FSC widens the talent pool for insurer executives from 7 to 12 fields
items.summary_zh: 金管會鬆綁保險公司經理人專業背景規定，可延攬的跨領域人才由 7 類擴增至 12 類，新增醫療、投資、行銷、不動產及永續經濟等領域，新制已於 11 月 22 日生效。此舉旨在協助保險業延攬商品創新、風險管理及接軌新一代清償能力與會計制度所需的更廣泛人才。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission has relaxed the professional-background requirements for insurance-company managers, expanding eligible cross-disciplinary expertise from seven to twelve categories, adding fields such as medicine, investment, marketing, real estate and sustainability. Effective Nov 22, the change aims to help insurers recruit the broader skill sets needed for product innovation, risk management and the transition to new solvency and accounting regimes.

items.title_zh: 穩定幣發行初期限銀行或金融業合資（持股逾 51%）
items.title_en: Stablecoin issuance to be limited to banks or bank-led ventures in first phase
items.summary_zh: 金管會「穩定幣發行許可及管理辦法」草案規劃，初期發行資格限於銀行，或採金融業持股過半（逾 51%）的合資模式；相關子法最快明年第一季上路並開放業者申請。此一架構顯示台灣對受監理數位資產貨幣採取以銀行為核心的審慎立場。
items.summary_en: The FSC's draft stablecoin licensing and management rules would initially restrict issuance to banks, or to joint ventures in which financial institutions hold a majority (over 51%) stake. Subordinate regulations are targeted to take effect as early as the first quarter of next year, when firms could begin applying. The framework signals a cautious, bank-anchored approach to regulated digital-asset money in Taiwan.

items.title_zh: 主動式 ETF 持續擴容，投信推出 AI 與股票新策略
items.title_en: Active ETFs multiply as asset managers roll out new AI and equity strategies
items.summary_zh: 台灣財富管理商品架上持續擴大，主管機關核准多檔新成立的主動式 ETF，包括一檔主動式 AI 科技台股 ETF（代號 00419A）。此一擴張為高資產與一般投資人提供更多主動管理、主題導向的工具，反映台灣規模約 36 兆元的財富管理市場，正朝基金、ETF 與全權委託等方向結構性轉移。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's wealth-management shelf continues to broaden, with regulators approving a wave of newly established active ETFs, including an actively managed AI-technology Taiwan-equity ETF (ticker 00419A). The expansion gives high-net-worth and retail clients more actively managed, theme-driven vehicles, reflecting a structural shift in the island's NT$36-trillion wealth-management market toward funds, ETFs and discretionary mandates.

items.title_zh: 壽險業配合 TIS 清償能力新制調整資產負債
items.title_en: Insurers adjust balance sheets as TIS solvency regime takes hold
items.summary_zh: 隨新一代清償能力制度（TIS）上路，保險業重新調整資產、負債與資本結構，主管機關並提供過渡措施，例如部分資本溢額可分最長 15 年攤銷。對財富管理客戶而言，此一轉變牽動儲蓄型、結構型與傳承型保單的設計與定價，而這類商品仍是高資產配置的核心一環。
items.summary_en: With the new-generation solvency system (TIS) now in force, insurers are reshaping assets, liabilities and capital, and regulators have provided transition measures such as allowing certain capital surpluses to be amortized over up to 15 years. For wealth clients, the shift influences the design and pricing of savings, structured and legacy-oriented insurance products that remain core components of high-net-worth portfolios.
